name: Article 4, § 5/2
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on speeding-up environmental assessments
part_text: ‘When preparing an environmental assessment report, the developer of a project shall be allowed to use data or information as old as five years, including data collected or supplied for other environmental assessments, provided that the data into the report take into account the site-specific conservation objectives of Natura 2000 sites where relevant, more recent data is not available, and the environmental conditions in which the data were collected have not substantially changed in a way that is likely to influence the environmental impact assessment.’
